title: Final Energy Bound
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the upper bound on the ground state energy E_0.

title: Minimization Step
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and perform the minimization of the energy expression with respect to the parameter beta.

title: Comparison with Exact Result
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately compare the variational result for n=1 with the known exact result.

title: Integral Evaluation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly evaluate the integral J(n) and apply it in the energy expression.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all terms in the final energy expression have consistent units.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of the Gaussian trial function.

title: Parameter Interpretation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly interpret the physical significance of the parameter beta in the context of the problem.
